description: This file defines a class 'RideState' for managing ride-related state in a Flutter application. It utilizes ChangeNotifier to notify UI components of state changes, effectively acting as a state management solution similar to ViewModels, with methods to set and reset ride-related data.

classes.name: RideState
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier class for managing ride state, including distance, destination info, ride requested status, and current address.

methods.name: setDistance
methods.description: Sets the trip distance and notifies listeners.

methods.name: requestRide
methods.description: Marks a ride as requested and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setDestinationAddress
methods.description: Updates the destination address and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setDestinationCoords
methods.description: Sets the destination latitude and longitude, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: setCurrentAddress
methods.description: Updates the current user address and notifies listeners.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all ride state data to initial default values and notifies listeners.
